levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Only one source is used and no disagreement or emphasis difference is noted.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Two sources (or the reference profile as one full source) are used and summarized.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Two sources are used and the learner names a specific point where they disagree or differ in emphasis.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Summary restates the job title rather than naming actual tasks (e.g., 'they help people').

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Summary names at least three concrete tasks from the research.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Summary names concrete tasks and identifies one task the learner did not expect.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Comparison is vague ('I was pretty close') with no specific citation of what the sources said.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Names one accurate and one inaccurate part of the prediction, citing the sources.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Names accurate and inaccurate parts with citations, and the reflection ties the reaction to a specific named task.

lookFors: The pre-research prediction is written honestly before the research task, not adjusted afterward.
The comparison in t3 names a specific task rather than a general impression.
The reflection names one concrete task as the cause of the interest shift, not a vague 'it was interesting.'

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
